svg.title: .SYSTEMX — AGENT X detailed field guide
svg.desc: Agent X records observed events, due items, and closure without executing scheduled work or sending notifications. This image also lists the exact folder, example prompt, CLI surfaces, five or six process steps, and role boundary.
svg.text: Event history, timing, and due-item records
Record this observed check and its time.
Show what is due, then close the record when reviewed.
Agent X records history and due status; it does not run a scheduler.
A due item does not send a notification or perform an external action.
